name: Wick: Bible Before Apps
subtitle: Read first. Scroll later.
promotionalText: Keep your light burning. Wick keeps distracting apps locked until you read today's chapter, reflect on it, and answer a few questions about it.
description:
Wick keeps your most distracting apps locked until you have spent time in the Bible. Read a chapter, reflect on it, answer a few questions, and your apps open. Keep your light burning, one day at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
• Make a lock and pick the apps that pull you in, like social media, games, or video.
• Choose when it locks: all day or certain hours, on the days you pick.
• Read today's chapter in your own Bible, in Wick, out loud, or by listening.
• Reflect by typing, speaking, or answering short prompts. Paste is turned off.
• Answer questions written for that exact chapter.
• Your apps open for as long as your lock allows.

QUESTIONS FOR EVERY CHAPTER
Every one of the Bible's 1,189 chapters has its own questions, from Genesis to Revelation. Multiple choice, fill in the blank phrases, put events in order, and true or false. They range from fair to genuinely challenging, and if you truly read the chapter, you will know the answers. Miss too many and Wick shows the verses you missed, then gives you new questions after a short wait.

READ IT YOUR WAY
• Paper Bible with a reading timer that keeps you honest
• Read in Wick with the words of Jesus in red
• Read it aloud: the words light up as you say them
• Listen with iPhone voices or optional natural voices
• A title for every chapter so you know what is coming

LOCKS THAT FIT YOUR LIFE
Make as many locks as you want, each with its own apps, days, hours, and rules. Unlock once for the day, answer a question every time, or allow only a few unlocks a day, shown as dots right on the lock screen. Choose how long each unlock lasts, from 30 seconds to the rest of the day. Protect your settings with a passcode, a waiting timer, a delay, or a commitment date, and even block deleting apps.

TROPHIES AND STREAKS
Earn more than 120 trophies for finishing books, themed journeys, streaks, perfect quizzes, holy days, and spending less time on your locked apps. Your closest trophies show up on the Today screen, and a friendly daily reminder helps you keep your streak.

PLANS FOR EVERY SEASON
Read any of the 66 books, the whole Bible, or short plans for hard seasons, big questions, and the great stories: anxiety, grief, doubt, temptation, who Jesus is, how to pray, the life of David, the story of Joseph, and many more.

ALSO INCLUDED
• A private journal you can browse by date or by book
• Weekly Screen Time trends for the apps you lock
• Automatic backup to your own iCloud
• Emergency passes for real emergencies
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Phone, Messages, and Maps are never locked

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Apple's Screen Time keeps your app choices private, even from Wick, and your reflections stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud.

“Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.” Psalm 119:105
reviewNotes:
No account or sign in is required.

Wick uses the Family Controls framework with individual authorization so a person can lock their own distracting apps until they finish a daily Bible reading.

To test the full flow:
1. Open Wick and go through setup. Tap Allow Screen Time access and approve with Face ID or passcode.
2. On Your first lock, tap Continue to open the lock editor. Enter a name, tap Choose, and pick any app, for example Safari. Tap Next through When it locks and How it unlocks, keeping the defaults.
3. On Reading check, set Minimum reading time to Off and Words to type to 20 to move faster. On Protect this lock, choose None. Tap Create lock.
4. Pick the Gospel of John and finish setup. Open the app you chose. The Wick lock screen appears.
5. Tap the button on the lock screen. Apple does not allow a shield to open another app, so Wick posts a local notification. Tap it to open Wick.
6. Tap Start reading, choose Read in Wick, and tap Finished the chapter. Type a short reflection about John 1 (mention John the Baptist, the Word, or the light), then answer the questions. Passing unlocks the app.

Shortcut: Settings, Reading, turn on Allow "I already read it" to skip straight to the reflection and questions.

Other features: speaking a reflection and Read it aloud use the microphone with on device speech recognition. Natural voices are optional; the open source Kokoro voice model (Apache 2.0) downloads only if the person picks one. The daily reminder is a local notification. Backup uses the person's own iCloud key value storage. The weekly chart uses a DeviceActivityReport extension and usage thresholds come from a DeviceActivityMonitor extension. No data is sent to us.

Bible text is the World English Bible, which is in the public domain.
